name: Carta LP Portal

web.notes: Single LP login across all funds administered on Carta. 2FA set up at registration; methods not confirmed. Multi-select download of K-1s, capital notices and annual reports.

api.notes: Public docs and a mock server; production access requires Carta approval. Suites: Launch, Investor (portfolio cap-table data for fund operators), Issuer, Portfolio, CRM. No LP self-serve path for fund-account data found.

mcp.notes: Vendor remote MCP server, Anthropic-verified connector since May 2026. Tools include discover, fetch, list_accounts, cap_table_chart. Fund performance and accounting data for investors are mentioned; documents and capital calls are not. LP coverage unconfirmed.

sftp.notes: Only for the separate Carta LP Portfolio Analytics product (formerly Accelex).

email_notifications.notes: Capital call notices emailed from investor-notices@carta.com with a link into the portal.

terms.notes: Terms page returned HTTP 403 to the researcher.

notes: High confidence: public API docs with sandbox, production gated; vendor MCP server with OAuth sign-in. Carta also runs a fund administration service on this platform. Unknown: whether an LP can use the MCP server or an API scope for their own commitments; terms on automation.
